name: Queens Knights
headerMeta: Golden era · Buckler infantry · shields · 280 leadership · S-Tier · T5 · Seasonal (Lancelot Knights / Queen's Knights)
pitch: An invincible-dash duelist that wins one-on-one trades and shreds low-count squads through pure timing. The engage kit was reworked in the 2026-06-25 patch (block, block-recovery, and Run 'Em Through invincibility windows all changed), so the timing advice below predates that change and should be treated as unverified until a post-patch source confirms it still holds.

veterancy.label: Top Line
veterancy.body: Amya's only recommendation; no second veterancy source exists to compare against.

battleRole.tips: Timing on spell 1 (double-dash, invincible) is everything — no simple rule, learned per matchup; occasionally pressing 2 before 1 can flip the trade entirely. {1} Huge block and defense make it tanky enough to retreat after one dash-forward rather than push deeper into a bad trade. {1} All of this predates the 2026-06-25 rework of Base Block, Block recovery, and Run 'Em Through invincibility/stab-hit count — treat as unverified. {1}

cards.name: Madao Battalion
cards.why: hits hard enough that Madao control calls for a soft-engagement combo (charge-brace-stab-brace) instead of a full charge-in

matchups.pressure: House investment-priority list ranks it "safe to doctrine up" alongside Iron Reapers, Liaos Rangers, Symmachean Stalwarts, Symmachean Paladins, Spartans, Modao — a signal it's worth committing resources to, not a matchup claim. {3}

controls.notes: Spell 1 — dashes forward twice (occasionally three times) dealing big damage; unit is completely invincible during this attack. {1} Spell 2 — small shieldbash, okay-ish damage, good block/counter. {1}

gaps: No house-card doctrines+mastery build exists — confirmed genuine gap after a full #vet-and-docs scroll-through + server-wide Discord search. A card for 'Queen's Paladins' does exist but is very likely a different unit (StarBurst's own grind-target list names them separately); it is deliberately not used here.

Pre-2026-06 rework advice: the only how-to-use source (Amya) predates the 2026-06-25 patch's core skill rework (Base Block 750→950, Block recovery 27→47, Run 'Em Through invincibility 1s→1.6s but max stab hits 3→2, blocking units no longer trigger weapon-bounce Dazed). Because this is a mechanic rework and not a numeric tweak, the timing advice above may be actively wrong, not merely outdated.
